README: The facts about this tool that appear in more than one place. Every script in publish/ reads them from here so they can never be typed twice and drift. Fill these in ONCE, at step 1 of TEMPLATE.md, before you build anything. node publish/preflight.mjs is red until you do.

NOTES.slug: lowercase, a-z0-9 and hyphens. It is the zip filename (<slug>-<version>.zip) and the local part of the Firefox add-on id. Not shown to users.
NOTES.ownerDomain: a domain you actually control. gecko.id is derived as <slug>@<ownerDomain> and AMO fixes the add-on identity at FIRST SIGNING — a placeholder that ships once is a permanently wrong identity, not a fixable typo. This is why the packaging gate refuses to write the Firefox package while the placeholder is here.
NOTES.supportEmail: goes in the store listing's support field. A real inbox someone reads.
NOTES.privacyPolicyUrl: where publish/PRIVACY-POLICY.html is HOSTED. The Chrome Web Store submission is blocked without it, and the URL must serve the policy over https with no login.
NOTES.homepageUrl: optional; leave empty if there is no site.
